result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d deepen humanity’s capacity for genuine empathy — the ability to truly understand one another across fear, ideology, and distance.

So many conflicts, inequalities, and forms of cruelty persist not because people lack intelligence, but because it’s easy to see “the other” as less real, less complex, or less deserving. If empathy were as instinctive as breathing, many of the world’s hardest problems would become solvable.
